formula: The largest / smallest figure was recorded for X
note: Класична фраза для найвищого чи найнижчого стовпчика.
example: The largest figure was recorded for Brazil, at 3.4 million tonnes.

exercises.practice: Brazil exported the most, 3.4 million tonnes, while Chile exported the least, only 0.2 million.
exercises.answer: The largest figure was recorded for Brazil, at 3.4 million tonnes, while the smallest was recorded for Chile, at just 0.2 million.
exercises.answerNote: Одна структура одразу описує і найбільший, і найменший стовпчик.

exercises.practice: Germany had the highest number of visitors, 12 million, while Portugal had the lowest, 1.5 million.
exercises.answer: The largest figure was recorded for Germany, at 12 million visitors, while the smallest was recorded for Portugal, at 1.5 million.
exercises.answerNote: "had the highest/lowest number" → "the largest/smallest figure was recorded for".

exercises.practice: Category A had the biggest score on the chart, 90 points, and Category E had the smallest, 10 points.
exercises.answer: The largest figure was recorded for Category A, at 90 points, while the smallest was recorded for Category E, at 10 points.
exercises.answerNote: Та сама формула працює для будь-яких категорій, не лише країн.

note: Коли йдеться про кількість людей чи предметів (не про відсотки).
example: Male employees outnumbered female employees by more than three to one.

exercises.practice: There were a lot more men working in construction than women, 890 compared to 240.
exercises.answer: Men working in construction outnumbered women by more than three to one, at 890 compared to 240.
exercises.answerNote: "a lot more... than" → outnumbered; додали точне співвідношення "three to one".

exercises.practice: There were a lot more cars than bicycles on the road, 4,200 compared to 300.
exercises.answer: Cars outnumbered bicycles on the road by a wide margin, at 4,200 compared to 300.
exercises.answerNote: "a wide margin" — коли не хочеш рахувати точне співвідношення.

exercises.practice: Female applicants were fewer than male applicants for the engineering course, 60 versus 340.
exercises.answer: Male applicants outnumbered female applicants for the engineering course by more than five to one, at 340 versus 60.
exercises.answerNote: Менше число переставили в кінець, більше — підметом речення з "outnumbered".

formula: X was twice / three times as high as Y
note: Коли можна порахувати точну кратність між двома стовпчиками.
example: Spending on rent was three times as high as spending on utilities.

exercises.practice: The company spent much more on advertising than on training, $60,000 against $20,000.
exercises.answer: The company's spending on advertising was three times as high as its spending on training, at $60,000 against $20,000.
exercises.answerNote: Порахували кратність (60 000 ÷ 20 000 = 3) і виразили її прямо в реченні.

exercises.practice: The price of the deluxe room was twice the price of the standard room, $200 against $100.
exercises.answer: The price of the deluxe room was twice as high as that of the standard room, at $200 against $100.
exercises.answerNote: "the price of the standard room" → "that of the standard room" вдруге.

exercises.practice: Water usage in July was four times higher than in January, 500 litres compared to 125 litres.
exercises.answer: Water usage in July was four times as high as in January, at 500 litres compared to 125 litres.
exercises.answerNote: "four times higher than" → академічніше four times as high as.

formula: There was a sharp contrast between X and Y in [category]
note: Універсальний вислів для bar chart, коли категорій кілька.
example: There was a sharp contrast between the two age groups in gym attendance.

exercises.practice: Younger and older respondents had very different answers about eating out, 65% versus 12%.
exercises.answer: There was a sharp contrast between younger and older respondents in terms of eating out, at 65% versus 12%.
exercises.answerNote: Додали "in terms of" — типова конструкція, щоб вказати, ЩО саме порівнюємо.

exercises.practice: City and rural dwellers had very different opinions about public transport, 70% satisfied versus 20%.
exercises.answer: There was a sharp contrast between city and rural dwellers in terms of satisfaction with public transport, at 70% versus 20%.
exercises.answerNote: Та сама структура, інша тема — формула не змінюється, змінюються лише категорії.

exercises.practice: Small and large companies had very different attitudes to remote work policies.
exercises.answer: There was a sharp contrast between small and large companies in terms of their attitudes to remote work policies.
exercises.answerNote: Працює і без конкретних цифр — просто для описової різниці.

formula: X clearly stood out as the highest column, well ahead of Y
note: Образний вислів — коли один стовпчик явно домінує над іншими.
example: Housing clearly stood out as the highest expenditure category, well ahead of transport.

exercises.practice: Housing costs were much higher than any other cost, way more than food or transport.
exercises.answer: Housing clearly stood out as the highest expenditure category, well ahead of both food and transport.
exercises.answerNote: "way more than" звучить розмовно — замінили на формальне "well ahead of".

exercises.practice: Football was much more popular than any other sport among the students surveyed.
exercises.answer: Football clearly stood out as the most popular sport, well ahead of any other option.
exercises.answerNote: Формула працює і для "популярності", не лише для грошей.

exercises.practice: Sales in the flagship store were much higher than in any of the other branches.
exercises.answer: The flagship store clearly stood out with the highest sales, well ahead of all the other branches.
exercises.answerNote: "clearly stood out with" — невеликий варіант формули для магазинів/філій.
